description: This file defines the EmploymentContractDao class, which manages database operations related to employment contracts within the OrangeHRM's PIM module. It provides methods to retrieve and save employment contract entities based on employee number.

classes.name: EmploymentContractDao
classes.description: Data access object for employment contracts, extending the base DAO providing methods to retrieve and save employment contract entities.

methods.name: getEmploymentContractByEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches an employment contract based on employee number.

methods.name: saveEmploymentContract
methods.description: Saves or updates an employment contract entity in the database.
